Companion Animal Travel Desk purpose and handling rules

This section sets the minimum standard for animal acceptance, documentation, and safe transfer at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must keep communication prompt and respectful, and they must record every service change in the desk ledger before the animal moves onward. The desk accepts only animals that are properly presented, calm enough for handling, and matched to the traveler record. When a large dog is accepted, the applicable fee must be recorded by the system-generated entry. <<FACT F057>> Staff must not improvise exceptions, waive controls, or rely on verbal memory when the ledger can be used.

The desk team must inspect crate condition, ventilation, locking points, and identification before transfer. Any damaged carrier, missing tag, or uncertain match between traveler and animal requires immediate hold and review by the senior coordinator. Staff must speak clearly to the traveler, confirm the route status, and note any service change without delay. If the animal shows distress, the handler must stop the transfer, secure the area, and call for assistance. Food, water, and cleaning supplies must be provided only as permitted by the approved care process, and all contact with the animal must remain calm, firm, and brief.

No staff member may release an animal to a traveler until the record is complete and the handoff is verified. If the desk receives conflicting instructions, the matter must be escalated at once and the animal kept under observation until resolved. For any uncertain case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
